blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — National University-Archipelago Builders debuted in style after beating VNS Always Bright Laticrete, 25-14, 25-13, 20-25, 25-12, in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Tuesday at Mall of Asia Arena. The Bulldogs unleashed a balanced attack powered by Obed Mukaba, who provided eight of their 18 blocks and finished with 17 points. RK Medino, who played for VNS last season, haunted his former team and finished with 15 points. V-League MVP Jade Disquitado also scored 15, highlighted by four aces.
